en.lead: Archron project is a project of Atelier Archron, a studio for image production and visual culture.

zh.lead: Archron project 是 Atelier Archron 的项目计划。Atelier Archron 关注图像生产及视觉文化。

en: Jialing Sun was born in the waterside towns of Jiangsu, China in 1995, later studied at the School of the Art Institute of Chicago, and currently lives and works in Changzhou. Her practice spans printmaking, painting, and writing, extending into the making of artist books and the running of community workshops.

She is drawn to closeness — close enough to see the grooves in bark, the patches of warm and cool light across a shoulder, the small human moments that almost pass unnoticed. Her paintings, her woodblock lines, and her poems share the same instinct: one scene, one person, one fragment, enlarged until it becomes a whole world.

This cross-cultural experience has rooted her work in the space between two worlds. She writes and paints Black musicians and Mexican migrants, a shoplifter in Carrefour and a security guard in a small port town — people from entirely different places and lives who nonetheless share the same fundamental human condition. She adopts an observer’s gaze: attentive, unhurried, and without judgment.

Her artist books A Long Day and Olivia’s Little Stones are held in the permanent collections of the School of the Art Institute of Chicago; her work has also been included in Guanxiang, a group exhibition at the Nanjing University of the Arts. In community practice, she has led woodblock printing workshops at Baidu Bookstore and Lushan Community House, and presented an artist book talk at the Liangxi District Library in Wuxi, bringing printmaking and the art of the book into contemporary community spaces. Her poetry, meanwhile, has appeared in Yangtze River Poetry Journal, Poetry Journal, Star Poetry Monthly, and other publications.
zh: 孙艺畅 1995 年生长于江苏无锡，后就读于芝加哥艺术学院，目前工作、生活于常州。她的创作横跨绘画、写作，同时延伸至艺术家书籍的制作与公共工作坊的实践。
她习惯把目光贴近事物——近到足以看见树皮的沟壑、光线在肩颈处铺陈的色块，以及那些细小到几乎被忽视的人间瞬间。她的画如此，她刻入木板的线条如此，她的诗也如此：一个场景，一个人，一个碎片，被放大成完整的世界。
这段横跨东西的经历，使她的创作浸润在两种文化的间隙里。她书写并描绘黑人歌手、墨西哥移民、家乐福里的小偷、小镇上的保安——来自不同国家、过着截然不同生活的人，却共享着生而为人最共通的底色。她偏爱旁观者的视角：不远不近，不凝视，不评判，只发现。
她的两本艺术家书籍《A Long Day》与《Olivia’s Little Stones》现为芝加哥艺术学院图书馆永久收藏，其作品亦曾参加南京艺术学院群展「观象」。在社区实践层面，她曾在白读书店、麓山社群之家等空间主持木刻版画工作坊，并于无锡梁溪区图书馆举办艺术家书分享会，致力于将版画与书籍艺术带入当代社区语境。与此同时，她的诗歌作品见于《扬子江诗刊》《诗刊》《星星》诗月刊等刊物。

en: Changming Lin is an image-maker based in Chengdu. His practice spans photography, performance, publishing, design, and other interdisciplinary practices. He often creates images using historic photographic processes and new media. His long-term interests include urban transformation, gender, cultural heritage, and publications, among other areas. Over the past two years, he has been conducting research and practice in socially engaged art.
zh: 林常名，图像工作者，现居成都。创作涉及摄影、行为、出版与设计等跨学科实践，常以古典摄影工艺及新型媒介进行图像创作。其长期关注城市变迁、性别、文化遗迹及出版物等。近两年围绕社会参与式艺术展开研究与实践。

en: Now in its 54th edition, the fair opens in Shanghai on 4 December 2026 and runs three days at the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition Hall — 2,500 square metres, 185 exhibitors and 100 collaborating makers.

The programme is framed by what the fair calls “limited freedom” and “given conditions”: a public, educational stance led by makers, with no imposed narrative and no settled conclusion. What the fair builds instead is the space between author and reader, where the viewer’s own reading can begin.

Four sections run through the fair — Artist’s Book, Handmade Book, Freezine® and Publication. Freezine®, the fair’s long-running project, keeps a space open for artists, designers and publishers to talk through art book publishing. Here the art book is placed once again in re-anchored coordinates: no longer a single object, but a moving possibility.
Atelier Archron appears with recent titles from the archron project, together with printed extras and related matter.

description.en: On a mountaintop live Olivia and her family. One day, an evil warlock descends on their little home and stirs up a storm. Olivia, who has never ventured far, must walk alone into the dark forest — a place of magic and sorcery, where forest spirits dwell. Can she find a way to repel the warlock? Sit back, relax, and fall into an adventure that begins by accident, following this wonderfully expressive little girl’s steps.
description.zh: 山顶上住着奥利薇一家。有一天，邪恶巫师降临这个小家，掀起风浪。从未远行的奥利薇只能独自走进黑森林——那里既有魔法与巫术，也有森林精灵栖息。她能从中找到驱散巫师的办法吗？你可以放轻松，跟着这个神情诙谐的小女孩，掉进一次意外开启的冒险旅程。

works.title: I’m the Curator of My Own Fucking Boring Life

en: Reading it requires no interest, patience, or meaning — only a boring stretch of time. If you don’t have one, please queue in place and wait for it to grow.

Since life is already boring, why not be a little more boring: watch the escalator carry you up, then down; move back and forth between the waiting hall, the number dispenser, the photocopier, and the subway turnstile, and on the fourth lap forget why you were walking.
Waste time thoroughly. Time agreed, but it didn’t show up.
zh: 读它不需要兴趣、耐心或意义，只需要一段无聊的时间。若没有，请在原地排队，等它长出来。
既然生活已经无聊，我们为什么不更无聊一点：看自动扶梯把自己送上去，再送下来；在候车厅、取号机、复印机和地铁闸机之间来回，走到第四圈时忘记为什么要走。
把时间浪费得彻底一些。时间同意了，但它没来。
